title: Concept: Script loaded over plaintext HTTP
description: A script element that points at plaintext HTTP in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A plaintext script is fetched without integrity, so anyone on the path can replace it and run code inside the page that handles the customer's credentials.
applicability: Deployments that render a script element that points at plaintext HTTP into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: A plaintext script is fetched without integrity, so anyone on the path can replace it and run code inside the page that handles the customer's credentials.
